method.geometry: Exact sphere geometry in the Moon-fixed ME frame: great-circle rays from the site, e = atan2(r_t cos(theta) - r_o, r_t sin(theta)); curvature counted once; negative elevations kept.

radial_sampling.note: ray sampling distance, not terrain resolution: the LDEM is bilinearly interpolated at each sample; step <= 1/4 of a 20 m pixel within 2 km and <= 1/2 beyond (1/6 of a 60 m pixel in the far-field product). Terrain detail is limited by the pixel spacing and LOLA track density.

stopping_rule.basis: global LOLA maximum 10773 m (LDEM_64 label) + 100 m
stopping_rule.rule: stop when e(R + h_max, theta) < running maximum

method.unknown_rule: ray leaves every product before the stop rule is met -> elevation null
method.observer_cell: observer foot = bilinear LDEM_80S_20M surface at the site, the same surface sampled along the rays; eye = Horizons altitude (surface rounded to 0.1 m + 1 m). Samples start at 5.0 m. Near-field influence is measured in sensitivity.d_min.

sensitivity.note: Numerical sensitivity of the base method (same geometry, same data). Not an independent validation.
